property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer succeeds (does not revert) exactly when all external transferFrom calls to the callee succeed; the mutant inverts that check so it succeeds when an external call fails and reverts when it succeeds, which the test exposes by using a callee that can be toggled to succeed or revert.
change_summary: Invert the require on the call result so transfer continues when call fails and reverts when call succeeds, changing which inputs cause revert.
